heroHeadline: Day 105: World Cup T-4 Days; Plan Kukulkan Fully Operational; Guadalajara Violence -30%; El Sapo at Large
heroSubtitle: Day 105 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). PLAN KUKULKAN T-4 DAYS (June 7): FIFA World Cup 2026 opens June 11 (Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). Mexico's 99,000+ security personnel fully deployed at all three World Cup venues — Estadio Azteca, Estadio Akron (Guadalajara), Estadio BBVA (Monterrey). GUADALAJARA VIOLENCE -30%: Security analysts and multiple outlets document a 30% drop in organized criminal violence in Guadalajara's metro in the five months preceding June vs. the prior period — attributed to sustained SEDENA decapitation pressure and CJNG's voluntary blackout directive. CRITICAL CAVEAT: CJNG's structural footprint in Jalisco remains intact; El 03 commands Grupo Élite; El Sapo commands the military wing at large. All 8-nation travel warnings remain in effect. KOREA DAY IN ZAPOPAN (June 6): South Korea's World Cup squad held 'Korea Day' in Zapopan — CJNG's historic operational heartland — one of four World Cup team events in Guadalajara ahead of matches beginning June 15; InSight Crime assessed cartels unlikely to target tourist events but Jalisco has ~16,000 registered disappearances. CJNG BLACKOUT DIRECTIVE — DAY 105: CJNG's operational blackout for high-visibility violence remains in effect; analysts project post-tournament return to elevated baseline. CJNG JUNE ATTACK SURGE (Ongoing): 324 attacks in June 2026 alone — highest monthly total of the post-Mencho period (756 total Feb–June); low-profile territorial consolidation continues despite the blackout. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 105: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target — the pre-June 11 capture objective was not met; World Cup perimeter security has replaced offensive targeting as Mexico's primary focus. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 29: No confirmed successor plaza boss at Mexico's primary fentanyl precursor port, 29 days after El Chucky's arrest. CJNG COLOMBIAN MERCENARIES — PURÉPECHA PLATEAU: 60+ Colombian paramilitary operatives active across 10 Michoacán municipalities. 8-NATION TRAVEL WARNING CLUSTER: US, Canada, UK, Australia, Germany, France, New Zealand, and Japan all maintain heightened Mexico travel advisories for World Cup visitors. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 105): Ongoing — 'coordination without subordination' Mullin-Sheinbaum framework active. JUNE BILATERAL MULLIN MEETING: Pending, not yet formally calendared. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested Mar 11), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
